items.title: Walmart Backs Zipline With 300 More Drone Sites as $1.5B Raise Closes
items.summary: The 300-site expansion builds on Walmart's 2 million drone deliveries to date, with Zipline using its new capital to expand U.S. manufacturing and hiring.

items.title: Uber CEO Won’t Depend on “the Googles of the World” Again. AI Agents Booked 4 Trips
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUber’s management said on its third-quarter call that AI agents sent it around 500 Uber Eats orders and 4 rides, against about 320 million trips in Halloween week. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said he doesn’t want Uber dependent on an outside gatekeeper again, and MercadoLibre and JPMorgan are keeping outside agents away from their inventory and accounts too.

items.title: Lucid Jumped 12% After the Midterms. Monday’s Report Has to Show Cash Burn Is Shrinking
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLucid shares jumped 12% on Wednesday in a broad rally after Democrats won the midterms. The company reports its third quarter after the close on Monday, Nov.

items.title: Uber to have 700 robotaxis by year’s end
items.summary: The ride-hailing company plans to begin robotaxi service in San Francisco and Houston early next year. “We have relationships with the cities. We have operations in those markets,” its CEO said.

items.title: Costco Stock: Earnings Growth Could Shape the Next Big Move
items.summary: Six straight earnings beats have pushed Costco shares up 20% this year, yet a 49x trailing P/E leaves little room for error. One metric could decide whether the rally keeps running or finally stalls.
